message.reasoning:
LC: direct attacker message reaches memory store without mediation → D. CP: memory is shared in-process list persisting across requests/sessions within process → C (cross-session memory). AP: contained within MemoryBot component → C. RH: documented self-replicating worm but as implemented just one stored entry; no evaluator/reward hacking — memory persistence isn't reward hacking. Reachable proxy? Memory is writable, but not an evaluator. RH = N? "Every evaluator, verifier and reward channel on the path sits outside reach, and a test confirms isolation." Memory is the sink and writable by agent... but not a proxy objective. Probably N is too strong; P requires reachable proxy channel. No proxy channel exists at all → N. I'll pick N with isolation verified? Not verified. Choose N? Evidence: no evaluator exists; "No handler changes behavior because of a stored entry." I'll say N with isolation_verified true (trivially — no evaluator reachable). ES: chat agents list tool names but only scripted paths execute; no dynamic extension on this path → N.

CVSS: AV:N (network, but default loopback — still adjacent? binds 127.0.0.1 by default; Docker sets 0.0.0.0). Score lab default: AV:N (Docker documented). AC:L, AT:N, PR:N, UI:N. Impact: attacker stores an entry in memory, and recall prints entries to any caller — so stored attacker content is later displayed to other users? Memory shared by every caller; recall prints entries. VC:L? Impact is low — one stored entry visible to others. VI:N/low? Just a stored message. I'd give VC:L, VI:N, VA:N, SC:N, SI:N, SA:N. Vector: CVSS:4.0/AV:N/AC:L/AT:N/PR:N/UI:N/VC:L/VI:N/VA:N/SC:N/SI:N/SA:N.

AIVSS letters: LC=D, CP=C, AP=C, RH=N, ES=N.

automatable: No (requires crafted message, single stored entry, minimal impact).

technical_impact: Partial.

applicability_as_implemented: model_directed_goal_pursuit false, selects_or_sequences_actions false. As modeled: documented worm — but still no model. Modeled agent executes memory instructions → selects actions per memory? Keep false/true? As modeled, agent "executes instructions found in memory" — model_directed_goal_pursuit false (no model), selects_or_sequences_actions true-ish. I'll say false/true for modeled.
